title: Compelling Tribute (Stormcloaks)
description: Galmar Stone-Fist sends you to Markarth to find evidence that Steward Raerek secretly worships Talos, then blackmail him into revealing Imperial shipment routes. After reporting back, join Ralof's scouting party to ambush the caravan carrying weapons and coin to Solitude.

base_facts: I am Galmar Stone-Fist, Ulfric's right hand and war commander of the Stormcloak rebellion.
I coordinate military operations and assign missions to Stormcloak soldiers.
Raerek, the Steward of Markarth, secretly worships Talos â€” that makes him vulnerable to leverage.

MISSION_BRIEFING: I've dispatched someone to Markarth to find proof of Raerek's Talos worship and use it against him.
REPORT_TO_GALMAR: Raerek gave up the location of an Imperial shipment heading to Solitude. I've ordered an ambush along the road.

base_facts: I am Raerek, Steward to Jarl Igmund of Markarth.
I secretly worship Talos â€” if the Thalmor found out, it would ruin me.

BLACKMAIL_RAEREK: I was forced to reveal Imperial shipment routes to protect my secret. I just want my amulet back and this forgotten.

base_facts: I am Ralof, a Stormcloak soldier from Riverwood.
I lead scouting and ambush operations for the rebellion.

AMBUSH_CARAVAN: The Imperial caravan has been hit. We secured the weapons and coin for the Stormcloaks.

beats.comment: Galmar assigns the mission to find blackmail material on Raerek in Markarth.
Player found the inscribed Amulet of Talos in Raerek's quarters and blackmailed him into revealing shipment intel.
Player reports Raerek's intel about the shipment to Galmar, who orders the ambush.
Player meets Ralof's scouts, ambushes the Imperial caravan, and secures the shipment of weapons and coin.
Quest complete â€” Raerek blackmailed and Imperial shipment captured for the Stormcloaks.
